title: Fix keys edit-trio input messages by reference_call_id but testids remain slot-keyed
detail: The data key changes from `slot` to `call.reference_call_id`, but all three testids still embed `slot`. With two expanded calls sharing a slot (e.g. both landlord_ref), selectors duplicate and E2E can't address a row. The new test pins the slot-keyed scheme.
recommended_fix: Key the testids by `call.reference_call_id` too and update the test query accordingly, or document why slot-keyed selectors are intentionally retained.

title: Regression test never drives the Save path named in the bug repro
evidence:
+/// success toast (the #611 repro). This drives the REAL runtime path —
+/// and asserts both the dict write and the re-rendered value.
detail: The comment names the save-persistence half of #611 ('Save persisted the ORIGINAL contact with a success toast'), yet the test body only asserts the dict write and the re-rendered value. No save dispatch is simulated, so that half of the regression stays unverified.
recommended_fix: Extend the test to trigger the trio's save and assert the resulting payload or effect carries the edited values, not the prefill.

title: Re-render assertion string-matches serialized HTML
detail: Exact-substring matching on `element.to_string` output couples the test to Lustre's attribute serialization (quoting, ordering, escaping). Benign now, but breaks silently if rendering internals change rather than if the field regresses.
recommended_fix: Use lustre/dev/query to read the element's `value` attribute instead of string-matching serialized HTML.
